description: Defines the absl::zipf_distribution class for generating Zipf-distributed random integers, including parameter configuration, distribution logic, and I/O operators.

classes.name: zipf_distribution
classes.description: A template class for generating Zipf-distributed random integers with configurable parameters.

classes.name: zipf_distribution::param_type

methods.description: Resets the distribution state (no-op in this implementation).
